method: Each question run in fresh sandbox with copied candidate.py and only required copied packaged input files; no raw-source tree, other question outputs, reference artifacts or verifier files copied. Isolated by working-directory/input layout, not an operating-system network/filesystem sandbox.

scientific_review.transform: Reviewed q=4*pi*sin(theta/2)/1.5406, nonuniform-q trapezoidal weights and 2/pi prefactor; signed sine transform preserved. Intensity is an uncorrected PDF-like representation, correctly caveated.
scientific_review.classifier: Q1 uses only train split fitting, evaluates held-out repeats of known phases, equal-weight uncalibrated-score fusion; no claims about unseen-phase generalization.
scientific_review.mixtures: Q2 average training templates with nonnegative coefficients in XRD and signed transform spaces; exact supplied phase count required; normalized coefficients correctly described as spectral contributions rather than mass fractions.
scientific_review.experimental: Q4 uses simulated templates restricted by precursor formula list; merges polymorph weights by formula before ranking; minor percentages only used for aggregation/evaluation.
scientific_review.artifacts: Q3 uses controlled additive noise/background on already artifact-bearing release spectra; identical random standard normal draws across amplitudes create paired comparisons; 11 source repeats, 5 noise draws per level; windows are half-open except final endpoint inclusion. Signal-energy retention is correctly distinguished from retained classification information.
scientific_review.numerical_detail: NNLS Gram matrix includes 1e-10 diagonal numerical regularization. This yields negligible-ridge NNLS rather than an algebraically exact unregularized objective.

plot_review.Q1: Viewed both chemistry panels; three method markers consistent with result metrics. Generic Mixture group xlabel is harmless for single-phase condition.
plot_review.Q2: Viewed both panels; F1 decreases with phase count. Method ordering differs by system/group, consistent with numerical results.
plot_review.Q3: Viewed noise and background panels; high-r region amplifies relative noise and low-r region dominates smooth-background distortion. Overlapping window definitions are clear as separate comparisons.
plot_review.Q4: Viewed both panels; grouped secondary-phase recall varies non-monotonically with concentration for some methods; conclusions do not overclaim a universal detection limit.

updated_conclusion_review.Q1: PDF minus XRD differences and fusion improvement over best standalone match recorded results; complementarity count uses exactly-one-representation-correct cases and is restricted to fixed within-phase split.
updated_conclusion_review.Q2: Two-to-three phase effect sizes match group metrics; composition and abundance confounding is expressly acknowledged.
updated_conclusion_review.Q3: 5–40 Å compromise justified jointly by small smooth-background distortion, lower relative noise than 40–120 Å and approximately 60% retained baseline energy; conditional scope and approximately 40% energy sacrifice stated.
updated_conclusion_review.Q4: Endpoint recalls and counts of decreasing adjacent abundance steps match per-group data. Twelve mixtures per concentration and reused component identities acknowledged.

runtime_setup: Used the existing /tmp/torrisi-env Python environment with versions matching the pinned requirements; did not claim a fresh network package installation. All four analysis runs used new copied-code/input directories and fresh outputs.
